<pre class="text"><code>Optimization without measurement is guessing.
Measurement without methodology is noise.

<section id="learning-outcomes" class="level2 unnumbered">
<h2 class="unnumbered anchored" data-anchor-id="learning-outcomes">Learning outcomes</h2>
<ol type="1">
<li>Phân biệt model benchmark, service benchmark, system profiling và production monitoring<br>
</li>
<li>Metrics cốt lõi: latency (client/server), throughput, concurrency, request rate, batch, queue, compute, p50/p95/p99<br>
</li>
<li>Vì sao mean đánh lừa; vì sao p99 và knee point quan trọng với SLO<br>
</li>
<li>Methodology: warmup, tách build/infer, control variables, input đại diện, report distribution<br>
</li>
<li>Dùng <code>trtexec</code>: ceiling engine, flags ổn định, đọc H2D/enqueue/GPU/D2H, dumpProfile<br>
</li>
<li>Perf Analyzer (concurrency / request-rate) + đọc CSV; Model Analyzer sweep dưới constraint<br>
</li>
<li>Khi nào Nsight Systems / Compute; NVTX; Triton metrics và queue vs compute<br>
</li>
<li>Playbook symptom→evidence→hypothesis→experiment→fix→remeasure; case phổ biến<br>
</li>
<li>Workflow E2E + checklist production + tránh 10 lỗi đo phổ biến</li>
</ol>

<section id="sec-why-measure" class="level2" data-number="7.1">
<h2 data-number="7.1" class="anchored" data-anchor-id="sec-why-measure"><span class="header-section-number">7.1</span> Đo đúng trước khi tối ưu</h2>
<blockquote class="blockquote">
<p>Vì sao “chạy thử vài request rồi kết luận nhanh hơn” nguy hiểm — và tool nào trả lời câu hỏi nào?</p>
</blockquote>
<div class="callout callout-style-default callout-important no-icon callout-titled">
<div class="callout-header d-flex align-content-center">
<div class="callout-icon-container">
<i class="callout-icon no-icon"></i>
</div>
<div class="callout-title-container flex-fill">
<span class="screen-reader-only">Quan trọng</span>Ý chính
</div>
</div>
<div class="callout-body-container callout-body">
<p>Inference performance phụ thuộc hàng chục biến (shape, precision, batch, concurrency, network, queue, warmup…). Mean tốt hơn không đồng nghĩa p99 tốt hơn; engine nhanh trong <code>trtexec</code> không đồng nghĩa Triton service nhanh. Chọn <strong>đúng tool cho đúng câu hỏi</strong>.</p>
</div>
</div>
<p>Nhiều người làm: export ONNX → build engine → vài request → “nhanh hơn”. Cách đó bỏ qua biến như input shape, batch, precision, GPU/driver/CUDA/TRT version, preprocessing, H2D/D2H, network, dynamic batching, concurrency, queue, clocks/thermal, warmup, instance count, Python overhead, sync.</p>
<p>Một thay đổi có thể làm mean tốt hơn nhưng <strong>p99 xấu hơn</strong>, hoặc throughput tăng nhưng single-request latency tăng.</p>
<p>Nhìn hệ thống theo lớp — mỗi lớp có metric riêng; chỉ tối ưu đúng khi biết lớp nào chi phối:</p>
<pre class="text"><code>Client → (serialization, network) → Triton frontend
  → (parse, scheduler queue, dynamic batching) → Backend
  → (input copy/binding, enqueue) → GPU (kernels, bandwidth, Tensor Cores)
  → Backend output → (output copy, response serialize) → Client receive</code></pre>
<p>Engine nhanh trong <code>trtexec</code> nhưng Triton chậm thường vì: concurrency thấp, batching không gom được, serialize/preprocess đắt, output copy lớn, network, <code>instance_group</code> chưa khớp, queue lâu, hoặc GPU chia sẻ.</p>

<colgroup>
<col style="width: 21%">
<col style="width: 34%">
<col style="width: 43%">
</colgroup>

<div id="callout-5" class="callout-5-contents callout-collapse collapse">
<div class="callout-body-container callout-body">
<p><code>trtexec</code> = <strong>ceiling</strong> (engine có thể nhanh tới đâu?).<br>
Perf Analyzer = <strong>service</strong> dưới load.<br>
Model Analyzer = <strong>config search</strong>.<br>
<code>nsys</code> = <strong>timeline</strong> khi số đo chưa đủ.<br>
<code>ncu</code> = <strong>kernel</strong> khi đã biết kernel nghi ngờ.<br>
Prometheus / Triton metrics = <strong>production</strong> liên tục.</p>
<p>Không mở Nsight cho mọi thay đổi — chỉ khi numbers không giải thích được behavior.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>

<section id="sec-metrics" class="level2" data-number="7.2">
<h2 data-number="7.2" class="anchored" data-anchor-id="sec-metrics"><span class="header-section-number">7.2</span> Metrics và điểm đo</h2>
<blockquote class="blockquote">
<p>“Latency bao nhiêu?” đã đủ chưa — và concurrency khác batch thế nào?</p>
</blockquote>
<div class="callout callout-style-default callout-important no-icon callout-titled">
<div class="callout-header d-flex align-content-center">
<div class="callout-icon-container">
<i class="callout-icon no-icon"></i>
</div>
<div class="callout-title-container flex-fill">
<span class="screen-reader-only">Quan trọng</span>Ý chính
</div>
</div>
<div class="callout-body-container callout-body">
<p>Latency chỉ có nghĩa khi kèm <strong>điểm đo</strong>. Throughput phải kèm batch (request/s ≠ sample/s). <strong>Concurrency ≠ batch size</strong>. Percentile (đặc biệt p99) quan trọng hơn mean cho SLO; queue time thường đẩy tail khi gần saturation.</p>
</div>
</div>
<table class="caption-top table">
<thead>
<tr class="header">
<th style="text-align: left;">Điểm đo</th>
<th style="text-align: left;">Định nghĩa</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;">Client-side latency</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Client send start → client nhận response</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td style="text-align: left;">Server-side latency</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Server nhận request → server gửi response</td>
</tr>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;">Backend compute</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Backend bắt đầu → output sẵn sàng</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td style="text-align: left;">GPU compute</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">CUDA kernels start → done</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p>Câu hỏi bắt buộc kèm: đo ở đâu? Có network / serialization / queue / H2D-D2H / preprocess / warmup không?</p>
<p><strong>Throughput</strong> thường báo dạng requests/s, inferences/s, samples/s, tokens/s, images/s. Ví dụ: batch = 8 và 100 rps → <strong>800 samples/s</strong>. Báo throughput mà không nói batch là thiếu ngữ cảnh.</p>
<table class="caption-top table">
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 55%">
<col style="width: 45%">
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr class="header">
<th style="text-align: left;">Khái niệm</th>
<th style="text-align: left;">Ý nghĩa</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;"><strong>Concurrency</strong></td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Số request outstanding cùng lúc (vd. 1 vs 32)</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td style="text-align: left;"><strong>Batch size</strong></td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Số samples trong một request / một batch execution</td>
</tr>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;"><strong>Request rate</strong></td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Tốc độ client cố tình gửi (vd. 500 rps) — mô phỏng arrival</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p>Triton dynamic batching có thể gom nhiều request (concurrency cao) thành một batch execution lớn hơn.</p>
<table class="caption-top table">
<thead>
<tr class="header">
<th style="text-align: left;">Percentile</th>
<th style="text-align: left;">Ý nghĩa</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;">p50</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">50% request ≤ giá trị</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td style="text-align: left;">p90 / p95</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">90% / 95% request ≤ giá trị</td>
</tr>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;">p99 / p999</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">99% / 99.9% request ≤ giá trị</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p>Ví dụ p50 = 20 ms, p99 = 200 ms: đa số nhanh nhưng 1% rất chậm — với 1 triệu request/ngày là ~10 000 request bị ảnh hưởng.</p>
<p><strong>Queue time:</strong> chờ trước khi execute (gom batch, hết instance, GPU/CPU bận, rate limiter). Thường là nguyên nhân p99 tăng nhanh gần saturation.</p>
<p><strong>Compute time</strong> cũng nhiều lớp: compute input (copy/binding) → compute infer (runtime) → compute output; cộng GPU kernels. Queue cao ≠ kernel chậm.</p>
<div class="callout callout-style-default callout-tip no-icon callout-titled">
<div class="callout-header d-flex align-content-center collapsed" data-bs-toggle="collapse" data-bs-target=".callout-7-contents" aria-controls="callout-7" aria-expanded="false" aria-label="Toggle callout">
<div class="callout-icon-container">
<i class="callout-icon no-icon"></i>
</div>
<div class="callout-title-container flex-fill">
<span class="screen-reader-only">Mẹo</span>Client vs server latency breakdown
</div>
<div class="callout-btn-toggle d-inline-block border-0 py-1 ps-1 pe-0 float-end"><i class="callout-toggle"></i></div>
</div>
<div id="callout-7" class="callout-7-contents callout-collapse collapse">
<div class="callout-body-container callout-body">
<p>Perf Analyzer thường tách: Client Send, Network+Server Send/Recv, Server Queue, Server Compute Input / Infer / Output, Client Recv.<br>
Client ≫ Server → nghi network/serialization/client.<br>
Server Queue cao → capacity/batching/saturation.<br>
Compute Infer cao → model/backend đắt.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="sec-tail-knee" class="level2" data-number="7.3">
<h2 data-number="7.3" class="anchored" data-anchor-id="sec-tail-knee"><span class="header-section-number">7.3</span> Tail latency và knee point</h2>
<blockquote class="blockquote">
<p>Mean đẹp có đủ để đạt SLO không — knee nằm ở đâu trên latency–throughput curve?</p>
</blockquote>
<div class="callout callout-style-default callout-important no-icon callout-titled">
<div class="callout-header d-flex align-content-center">
<div class="callout-icon-container">
<i class="callout-icon no-icon"></i>
</div>
<div class="callout-title-container flex-fill">
<span class="screen-reader-only">Quan trọng</span>Ý chính
</div>
</div>
<div class="callout-body-container callout-body">
<p>SLO thường gắn <strong>p99</strong>, không phải mean. Gần saturation, latency ≈ service time + queueing; overload thì queue chiếm. Chọn <strong>operating point</strong> ở vùng knee dưới SLO, giữ <strong>headroom</strong> — không chạy sát 100% utilization.</p>
</div>
</div>
<p>SLO giả định: <strong>p99 &lt; 100 ms</strong>.</p>
<table class="caption-top table">
<thead>
<tr class="header">
<th style="text-align: left;">Run</th>
<th style="text-align: right;">mean</th>
<th style="text-align: right;">p50</th>
<th style="text-align: right;">p95</th>
<th style="text-align: right;">p99</th>
<th style="text-align: left;">Kết luận</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;">A</td>
<td style="text-align: right;">25 ms</td>
<td style="text-align: right;">20</td>
<td style="text-align: right;">60</td>
<td style="text-align: right;"><strong>180</strong></td>
<td style="text-align: left;"><strong>FAIL</strong> SLO</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td style="text-align: left;">B</td>
<td style="text-align: right;">30 ms</td>
<td style="text-align: right;">26</td>
<td style="text-align: right;">70</td>
<td style="text-align: right;"><strong>95</strong></td>
<td style="text-align: left;"><strong>PASS</strong></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p>Run A mean tốt hơn nhưng fail; Run B mean xấu hơn nhưng đạt SLO.</p>
<table class="caption-top table">
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 22%">
<col style="width: 37%">
<col style="width: 40%">
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr class="header">
<th style="text-align: left;">Vùng</th>
<th style="text-align: left;">Đặc điểm</th>
<th style="text-align: left;">Hành động</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;"><strong>Underutilized</strong></td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Concurrency thấp, GPU chưa fill, TP thấp, latency thấp</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Tăng concurrency/batch để lấy throughput</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td style="text-align: left;"><strong>Knee</strong></td>
<td style="text-align: left;">TP gần plateau, latency tăng rõ, gần saturation</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Thường là <strong>operating point</strong> tốt nếu SLO cho phép</td>
</tr>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;"><strong>Overload</strong></td>
<td style="text-align: left;">TP không tăng, latency/p99/queue tăng mạnh, timeout</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Không vận hành ổn định ở đây</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p>Mục tiêu benchmark: <strong>max throughput under latency SLO</strong> — không phải max throughput tuyệt đối. Ví dụ Config A 1000 rps / p99=80 ms (OK) thắng Config B 1200 rps / p99=160 ms (Fail).</p>
<p><strong>Little’s Law</strong> (sanity check): <span class="math inline">\(\text{concurrency} \approx \text{throughput} \times \text{latency}\)</span>. Với concurrency = 32 và latency = 40 ms (= 0.04 s) → throughput ≈ 32 / 0.04 = <strong>~800 rps</strong>. Nếu PA báo concurrency 32, mean 40 ms nhưng chỉ 100 rps — số đo hoặc concurrency giữ chưa khớp.</p>
<div class="cell" data-fig-width="6.5" data-layout-align="center">
<div class="cell-output-display">
<div id="fig-l7-knee" class="quarto-float quarto-figure quarto-figure-center anchored">
<figure class="quarto-float quarto-float-fig figure">

Hình&nbsp;7.2: Ba vùng trên latency–throughput curve: underutilized → knee → overload.
</figcaption>
</figure>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="callout callout-style-default callout-tip no-icon callout-titled">
<div class="callout-header d-flex align-content-center collapsed" data-bs-toggle="collapse" data-bs-target=".callout-9-contents" aria-controls="callout-9" aria-expanded="false" aria-label="Toggle callout">

</div>

</div>

</div>

</section>
<section id="sec-methodology" class="level2" data-number="7.4">
<h2 data-number="7.4" class="anchored" data-anchor-id="sec-methodology"><span class="header-section-number">7.4</span> Methodology chuẩn</h2>
<blockquote class="blockquote">
<p>Làm sao đo để so sánh được qua nhiều lần chạy — không trộn noise vào kết luận?</p>
</blockquote>
<div class="callout callout-style-default callout-important no-icon callout-titled">
<div class="callout-header d-flex align-content-center">
<div class="callout-icon-container">
<i class="callout-icon no-icon"></i>
</div>
<div class="callout-title-container flex-fill">
<span class="screen-reader-only">Quan trọng</span>Ý chính
</div>
</div>
<div class="callout-body-container callout-body">
<p>Luôn <strong>warmup</strong> (100–1000 iter), đo ổn định, lặp 3–5 lần, báo median + variance. <strong>Tách build engine khỏi infer</strong>. Ghi environment, cố định biến khi so sánh, dùng input đại diện, chạy đủ lâu, report <strong>distribution</strong> không chỉ mean.</p>
</div>
</div>
<p>Cold start gồm CUDA init, model load, deserialize, alloc, autotune/cache, first launch, page cache, Triton warmup — không đại diện steady-state.</p>
<p><strong>Sai:</strong> <code>time trtexec --onnx=model.onnx --fp16</code> (trộn build + infer).<br>
<strong>Đúng:</strong></p>
<div class="code-copy-outer-scaffold"><div class="sourceCode" id="cb3"><pre class="sourceCode bash code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb3-1"><a href="#cb3-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ex">trtexec</span> <span class="at">--onnx</span><span class="op">=</span>model.onnx <span class="at">--saveEngine</span><span class="op">=</span>model_fp16.plan <span class="at">--fp16</span> <span class="dt">\</span></span>
<span id="cb3-2"><a href="#cb3-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="at">--minShapes</span><span class="op">=</span>input:1x3x224x224 <span class="at">--optShapes</span><span class="op">=</span>input:8x3x224x224 <span class="at">--maxShapes</span><span class="op">=</span>input:32x3x224x224</span>
<span id="cb3-3"><a href="#cb3-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb3-4"><a href="#cb3-4" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ex">trtexec</span> <span class="at">--loadEngine</span><span class="op">=</span>model_fp16.plan <span class="at">--shapes</span><span class="op">=</span>input:8x3x224x224</span></code></pre></div><button title="Copy to Clipboard" class="code-copy-button"><i class="bi"></i></button></div>
<table class="caption-top table">
<thead>
<tr class="header">
<th style="text-align: left;">Thời lượng</th>
<th style="text-align: left;">Mục đích</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;">30–60 s / config</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Dev iteration nhanh</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td style="text-align: left;">Vài phút × nhiều lần</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Baseline nghiêm túc</td>
</tr>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;">Soak dài</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Production readiness</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p>Report nên có: throughput, mean, p50/p90/p95/p99, max, server queue/compute, GPU util/memory, errors/timeouts.</p>
<div class="callout callout-style-default callout-tip no-icon callout-titled">
<div class="callout-header d-flex align-content-center collapsed" data-bs-toggle="collapse" data-bs-target=".callout-11-contents" aria-controls="callout-11" aria-expanded="false" aria-label="Toggle callout">
<div class="callout-icon-container">
<i class="callout-icon no-icon"></i>
</div>
<div class="callout-title-container flex-fill">
<span class="screen-reader-only">Mẹo</span>Environment checklist + control variables
</div>
<div class="callout-btn-toggle d-inline-block border-0 py-1 ps-1 pe-0 float-end"><i class="callout-toggle"></i></div>
</div>
<div id="callout-11" class="callout-11-contents callout-collapse collapse">
<div class="callout-body-container callout-body">
<p>Ghi: Date, Machine, GPU/count, Driver, CUDA, cuDNN, TensorRT, Triton, ORT, Model name/version, Precision, Shape, Batch, Dynamic profile, Dataset/input gen, Warmup, Duration, Client machine, Protocol, Concurrency/RPS, <code>config.pbtxt</code>, Power/clocks, Other GPU workloads.</p>
<p>So sánh FP16 vs INT8: <strong>cùng</strong> GPU, driver, CUDA/TRT, input, shape, concurrency, Triton config (chỉ khác artifact). Không so A10+batch1 với L4+batch16.</p>
<p>Input đại diện: nếu production 70% <code>224×224</code>, 20% <code>512×512</code>, 10% <code>1024×1024</code> — chỉ bench <code>224</code> sẽ quá lạc quan (NLP/LLM: sequence length; detection: output size; sparse/recommender: distribution).</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="sec-trtexec" class="level2" data-number="7.5">
<h2 data-number="7.5" class="anchored" data-anchor-id="sec-trtexec"><span class="header-section-number">7.5</span> trtexec — engine ceiling</h2>
<blockquote class="blockquote">
<p>Engine nhanh tối đa bao nhiêu nếu bỏ service overhead — và H2D / enqueue / GPU nói gì?</p>
</blockquote>
<div class="callout callout-style-default callout-important no-icon callout-titled">
<div class="callout-header d-flex align-content-center">
<div class="callout-icon-container">
<i class="callout-icon no-icon"></i>
</div>
<div class="callout-title-container flex-fill">
<span class="screen-reader-only">Quan trọng</span>Ý chính
</div>
</div>
<div class="callout-body-container callout-body">
<p><code>trtexec</code> đo <strong>ceiling</strong> TensorRT: build/bench engine, precision, shape, per-layer. Không dùng nó để kết luận p99 production (thiếu scheduler, network, client, Python preprocess, queue). Đọc tách H2D, GPU Compute, D2H, Enqueue.</p>
</div>
</div>
<p>Dùng khi cần biết: ceiling latency/throughput; build OK?; FP16/INT8/shape/batch; layer hotspot; copy vs enqueue. Không đại diện đầy đủ Triton production.</p>
<div class="code-copy-outer-scaffold"><div class="sourceCode" id="cb4"><pre class="sourceCode bash code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb4-1"><a href="#cb4-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co"># Static</span></span>
<span id="cb4-2"><a href="#cb4-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ex">trtexec</span> <span class="at">--onnx</span><span class="op">=</span>model.onnx <span class="at">--saveEngine</span><span class="op">=</span>model_fp16.plan <span class="dt">\</span></span>
<span id="cb4-3"><a href="#cb4-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="at">--shapes</span><span class="op">=</span>input:1x3x224x224 <span class="at">--fp16</span></span>
<span id="cb4-4"><a href="#cb4-4" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb4-5"><a href="#cb4-5" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co"># Dynamic + bench saved</span></span>
<span id="cb4-6"><a href="#cb4-6" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ex">trtexec</span> <span class="at">--onnx</span><span class="op">=</span>model.onnx <span class="at">--saveEngine</span><span class="op">=</span>model_fp16_dynamic.plan <span class="at">--fp16</span> <span class="dt">\</span></span>
<span id="cb4-7"><a href="#cb4-7" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="at">--minShapes</span><span class="op">=</span>input:1x3x224x224 <span class="at">--optShapes</span><span class="op">=</span>input:8x3x224x224 <span class="at">--maxShapes</span><span class="op">=</span>input:32x3x224x224</span>
<span id="cb4-8"><a href="#cb4-8" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ex">trtexec</span> <span class="at">--loadEngine</span><span class="op">=</span>model_fp16_dynamic.plan <span class="at">--shapes</span><span class="op">=</span>input:8x3x224x224</span></code></pre></div><button title="Copy to Clipboard" class="code-copy-button"><i class="bi"></i></button></div>
<p>Flags ổn định hơn (ví dụ ResNet-50):</p>
<div class="code-copy-outer-scaffold"><div class="sourceCode" id="cb5"><pre class="sourceCode bash code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb5-1"><a href="#cb5-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ex">trtexec</span> <span class="at">--onnx</span><span class="op">=</span>resnet50-v1-12.onnx <span class="at">--shapes</span><span class="op">=</span>data:4x3x224x224 <span class="at">--fp16</span> <span class="dt">\</span></span>
<span id="cb5-2"><a href="#cb5-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="at">--noDataTransfers</span> <span class="at">--useCudaGraph</span> <span class="at">--useSpinWait</span></span></code></pre></div><button title="Copy to Clipboard" class="code-copy-button"><i class="bi"></i></button></div>
<p><code>--noDataTransfers</code> tập trung GPU compute; production nếu copy PCIe mỗi request thì <strong>cũng</strong> phải bench có transfer. <code>--useCudaGraph</code> giảm launch overhead; <code>--useSpinWait</code> ổn định latency hơn (CPU busy hơn).</p>
<table class="caption-top table">
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 20%">
<col style="width: 23%">
<col style="width: 56%">
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr class="header">
<th style="text-align: left;">Metric</th>
<th style="text-align: left;">Ý nghĩa</th>
<th style="text-align: left;">Nếu cao thì nghĩ tới</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;">Throughput</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">tốc độ inference</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">so với SLO và batch</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td style="text-align: left;">Host Latency</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">H2D + GPU + D2H</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">end-to-end engine path</td>
</tr>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;">Enqueue</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">CPU enqueue/launch</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">CPU bottleneck, tiny kernels, thiếu CUDA Graph</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td style="text-align: left;">H2D</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">input copy</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">input lớn, PCIe, thiếu pinned memory</td>
</tr>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;">GPU Compute</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">kernels</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">model compute, bandwidth, Tensor Core</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td style="text-align: left;">D2H</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">output copy</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">output lớn, postprocess CPU</td>
</tr>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;">Total Host Walltime</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">thời gian host thấy</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">underutilization nếu ≫ GPU compute</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td style="text-align: left;">Total GPU Compute</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">tổng GPU time</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">so với walltime → độ fill</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<table class="caption-top table">
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 21%">
<col style="width: 32%">
<col style="width: 46%">
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr class="header">
<th style="text-align: left;">Case</th>
<th style="text-align: left;">Pattern</th>
<th style="text-align: left;">Hướng xử lý</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;">A</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">GPU ≈ Host; H2D/D2H/Enqueue nhỏ</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Precision, batch, fusion, architecture, layer profile</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td style="text-align: left;">B</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">H2D hoặc D2H lớn</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Giữ tensor trên GPU, I/O Binding/shared mem, giảm output, pinned</td>
</tr>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;">C</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Enqueue &gt; GPU Compute</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">CUDA Graph, tăng batch, fusion, tránh sync, async</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td style="text-align: left;">D</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Total GPU ≪ Host Walltime</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Underutilized — giống B/C</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<div class="cell" data-fig-width="7" data-layout-align="center">
<div class="cell-output-display">

Hình&nbsp;7.3: Spine tô sáng giai đoạn Engine bench — ceiling trước khi đo service.

</div>
</div>
<div class="callout callout-style-default callout-tip no-icon callout-titled">
<div class="callout-header d-flex align-content-center collapsed" data-bs-toggle="collapse" data-bs-target=".callout-13-contents" aria-controls="callout-13" aria-expanded="false" aria-label="Toggle callout">
<div class="callout-icon-container">
<i class="callout-icon no-icon"></i>
</div>
<div class="callout-title-container flex-fill">
<span class="screen-reader-only">Mẹo</span>Per-layer, dynamic shape, precision
</div>
<div class="callout-btn-toggle d-inline-block border-0 py-1 ps-1 pe-0 float-end"><i class="callout-toggle"></i></div>
</div>
<div id="callout-13" class="callout-13-contents callout-collapse collapse">
<div class="callout-body-container callout-body">
<div class="code-copy-outer-scaffold"><div class="sourceCode" id="cb6"><pre class="sourceCode bash code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb6-1"><a href="#cb6-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ex">trtexec</span> <span class="at">--loadEngine</span><span class="op">=</span>model.plan <span class="at">--shapes</span><span class="op">=</span>input:8x3x224x224 <span class="dt">\</span></span>
<span id="cb6-2"><a href="#cb6-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="at">--profilingVerbosity</span><span class="op">=</span>detailed <span class="at">--dumpLayerInfo</span> <span class="at">--dumpProfile</span> <span class="at">--separateProfileRun</span></span></code></pre></div><button title="Copy to Clipboard" class="code-copy-button"><i class="bi"></i></button></div>
<p>Chú ý: Layer name, Time(%), type, precision, shape, tactic; một TRT layer có thể = nhiều ONNX ops (vd. Conv+BN+ReLU fused).</p>
<p>Dynamic: bench shape 1 / 8 / 32. <code>opt</code> nhanh nhưng <code>max</code> chậm không nhất thiết lỗi — builder tối ưu quanh <code>opt</code>. Production chủ yếu batch=1 mà <code>opt=32</code> → latency batch 1 có thể kém.</p>
<p>Precision: FP32 baseline; <code>--fp16</code>; INT8 Q/DQ với <code>--stronglyTyped</code>. INT8 có thể <strong>không</strong> thắng FP16 nếu model nhỏ, memory-bound, nhiều layer không INT8, Q/DQ overhead, copy chi phối, batch nhỏ, hoặc hardware không lợi rõ. Đo latency + throughput + accuracy + memory + p99 service trước khi kết luận.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="sec-perf-analyzer" class="level2" data-number="7.6">
<h2 data-number="7.6" class="anchored" data-anchor-id="sec-perf-analyzer"><span class="header-section-number">7.6</span> Perf Analyzer và Model Analyzer</h2>
<blockquote class="blockquote">
<p>Service chịu bao nhiêu load — và config nào đạt throughput dưới p99 SLO?</p>
</blockquote>
<div class="callout callout-style-default callout-important no-icon callout-titled">
<div class="callout-header d-flex align-content-center">
<div class="callout-icon-container">
<i class="callout-icon no-icon"></i>
</div>
<div class="callout-title-container flex-fill">
<span class="screen-reader-only">Quan trọng</span>Ý chính
</div>
</div>
<div class="callout-body-container callout-body">
<p>Perf Analyzer đo <strong>service behavior</strong> (concurrency hoặc request-rate, HTTP/gRPC, breakdown client/server). Model Analyzer <strong>sweep</strong> batch/instance/memory để maximize throughput <strong>subject to</strong> p99 &lt; SLO, memory budget, error = 0 — không chọn blindly max TP.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="code-copy-outer-scaffold"><div class="sourceCode" id="cb7"><pre class="sourceCode bash code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb7-1"><a href="#cb7-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co"># Concurrency mode: 1 → 64, step 4</span></span>
<span id="cb7-2"><a href="#cb7-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ex">perf_analyzer</span> <span class="at">-m</span> resnet50 <span class="at">-i</span> grpc <span class="at">--concurrency-range</span> 1:64:4 <span class="at">-f</span> perf_concurrency.csv</span>
<span id="cb7-3"><a href="#cb7-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb7-4"><a href="#cb7-4" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co"># Request-rate mode (mô phỏng arrival)</span></span>
<span id="cb7-5"><a href="#cb7-5" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ex">perf_analyzer</span> <span class="at">-m</span> resnet50 <span class="at">-i</span> grpc <span class="at">--request-rate-range</span> 100:2000:100 <span class="at">-f</span> perf_request_rate.csv</span>
<span id="cb7-6"><a href="#cb7-6" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb7-7"><a href="#cb7-7" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co"># Shape: nếu max_batch_size &gt; 0, --shape thường KHÔNG gồm batch dim</span></span>
<span id="cb7-8"><a href="#cb7-8" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ex">perf_analyzer</span> <span class="at">-m</span> resnet50 <span class="at">-i</span> grpc <span class="at">--shape</span> input:3,224,224 <span class="at">--concurrency-range</span> 1:32</span>
<span id="cb7-9"><a href="#cb7-9" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb7-10"><a href="#cb7-10" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ex">perf_analyzer</span> <span class="at">-m</span> resnet50 <span class="at">-i</span> grpc <span class="at">--input-data</span> input_data.json <span class="at">--concurrency-range</span> 1:32</span>
<span id="cb7-11"><a href="#cb7-11" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb7-12"><a href="#cb7-12" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ex">perf_analyzer</span> <span class="at">-m</span> resnet50 <span class="at">-i</span> grpc <span class="at">--concurrency-range</span> 1:64:4 <span class="dt">\</span></span>
<span id="cb7-13"><a href="#cb7-13" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="at">--collect-metrics</span> <span class="at">--verbose-csv</span> <span class="at">-f</span> perf_with_metrics.csv</span>
<span id="cb7-14"><a href="#cb7-14" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co"># metrics URL khác: --metrics-url http://server-host:8002/metrics</span></span></code></pre></div><button title="Copy to Clipboard" class="code-copy-button"><i class="bi"></i></button></div>
<p>CSV thường có: Concurrency, Inferences/Second, Client Send, Network+Server Send/Recv, Server Queue, Server Compute Input/Infer/Output, Client Recv, p50/p90/p95/p99 latency.</p>
<p>Model Analyzer ví dụ:</p>
<div class="code-copy-outer-scaffold"><div class="sourceCode" id="cb8"><pre class="sourceCode yaml code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode yaml"><span id="cb8-1"><a href="#cb8-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">model_repository</span><span class="kw">:</span><span class="at"> /models</span></span>
<span id="cb8-2"><a href="#cb8-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">profile_models</span><span class="kw">:</span></span>
<span id="cb8-3"><a href="#cb8-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="at">  </span><span class="fu">resnet50</span><span class="kw">:</span></span>
<span id="cb8-4"><a href="#cb8-4" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="at">    </span><span class="fu">parameters</span><span class="kw">:</span></span>
<span id="cb8-5"><a href="#cb8-5" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="at">      </span><span class="fu">batch_sizes</span><span class="kw">:</span><span class="at"> </span><span class="kw">[</span><span class="dv">1</span><span class="kw">,</span><span class="at"> </span><span class="dv">4</span><span class="kw">,</span><span class="at"> </span><span class="dv">8</span><span class="kw">,</span><span class="at"> </span><span class="dv">16</span><span class="kw">,</span><span class="at"> </span><span class="dv">32</span><span class="kw">]</span></span>
<span id="cb8-6"><a href="#cb8-6" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="at">      </span><span class="fu">concurrency</span><span class="kw">:</span><span class="at"> </span><span class="kw">[</span><span class="dv">1</span><span class="kw">,</span><span class="at"> </span><span class="dv">2</span><span class="kw">,</span><span class="at"> </span><span class="dv">4</span><span class="kw">,</span><span class="at"> </span><span class="dv">8</span><span class="kw">,</span><span class="at"> </span><span class="dv">16</span><span class="kw">,</span><span class="at"> </span><span class="dv">32</span><span class="kw">,</span><span class="at"> </span><span class="dv">64</span><span class="kw">]</span></span></code></pre></div><button title="Copy to Clipboard" class="code-copy-button"><i class="bi"></i></button></div>
<div class="code-copy-outer-scaffold"><div class="sourceCode" id="cb9"><pre class="sourceCode bash code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb9-1"><a href="#cb9-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ex">model-analyzer</span> profile <span class="at">--config-file</span> profile_config.yaml <span class="at">--triton-launch-mode</span><span class="op">=</span>local</span>
<span id="cb9-2"><a href="#cb9-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ex">model-analyzer</span> report <span class="at">--report-model-configs</span> resnet50_config_default</span>
<span id="cb9-3"><a href="#cb9-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co"># luôn: model-analyzer --help (flags theo version)</span></span></code></pre></div><button title="Copy to Clipboard" class="code-copy-button"><i class="bi"></i></button></div>
<p>Constraint: maximize TP s.t. <strong>p99 &lt; SLO AND mem budget AND error = 0</strong>.</p>
<div class="cell" data-fig-width="7" data-layout-align="center">
<div class="cell-output-display">
<div id="fig-l7-service" class="quarto-float quarto-figure quarto-figure-center anchored">
<figure class="quarto-float quarto-float-fig figure">
<div aria-describedby="fig-l7-service-caption-0ceaefa1-69ba-4598-a22c-09a6ac19f8ca">
<div>
<pre class="mermaid mermaid-js" data-label="fig-l7-service">flowchart LR
  A([Artifact]) --&gt;|"trtexec / ORT"| E([Engine bench])
  E --&gt;|"Perf Analyzer"| S([Service load])
  S --&gt;|"Metrics / MA"| M([Config + metrics])
  M --&gt;|"Nsight"| N([Timeline])
  N --&gt;|"optimize"| B([New baseline])
  classDef soft fill:#F7FAFC,stroke:#7B8A9A,stroke-width:1.5px,color:#243447
  classDef hot fill:#FFF8E1,stroke:#F9A825,stroke-width:2px,color:#5C3B10
  classDef ok fill:#EAF3FF,stroke:#4A90E2,stroke-width:1.5px,color:#1F3A5F
  class A,B,E,M,N soft
  class S hot
</pre>
</div>
</div>
<figcaption class="quarto-float-caption-bottom quarto-float-caption quarto-float-fig" id="fig-l7-service-caption-0ceaefa1-69ba-4598-a22c-09a6ac19f8ca">
Hình&nbsp;7.4: Spine tô sáng Service load — Perf Analyzer / Model Analyzer.
</figcaption>
</figure>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="callout callout-style-default callout-tip no-icon callout-titled">
<div class="callout-header d-flex align-content-center collapsed" data-bs-toggle="collapse" data-bs-target=".callout-15-contents" aria-controls="callout-15" aria-expanded="false" aria-label="Toggle callout">
<div class="callout-icon-container">
<i class="callout-icon no-icon"></i>
</div>
<div class="callout-title-container flex-fill">
<span class="screen-reader-only">Mẹo</span>Đọc Perf Analyzer theo 6 câu hỏi + HTTP/gRPC + MA report
</div>
<div class="callout-btn-toggle d-inline-block border-0 py-1 ps-1 pe-0 float-end"><i class="callout-toggle"></i></div>
</div>
<div id="callout-15" class="callout-15-contents callout-collapse collapse">
<div class="callout-body-container callout-body">
<table class="caption-top table">
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 13%">
<col style="width: 40%">
<col style="width: 45%">
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr class="header">
<th style="text-align: left;">#</th>
<th style="text-align: left;">Câu hỏi</th>
<th style="text-align: left;">Tín hiệu</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;">Q1</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">TP còn tăng khi concurrency tăng?</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Tăng nhẹ latency → chưa saturated; plateau + latency↑ mạnh → gần/overload</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td style="text-align: left;">Q2</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">p99 vượt SLO?</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">p50 tốt / p99 xấu → queue, jitter, batching, outlier</td>
</tr>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;">Q3</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Server Queue tăng?</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Tăng instance, chỉnh batch delay, giảm target concurrency, scale, tối ưu compute</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td style="text-align: left;">Q4</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Compute Infer vs Queue?</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Infer cao → model đắt; Queue cao → capacity; Client Send/Recv → network/payload</td>
</tr>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;">Q5</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">GPU util cao nhưng TP không tăng?</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Bandwidth, saturated, serialization, batch không scale, thermal</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td style="text-align: left;">Q6</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">GPU util thấp nhưng latency cao?</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">CPU/Python/network, concurrency thấp, batch nhỏ, H2D/D2H, sync, chờ batch</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p><strong>HTTP vs gRPC</strong> — đo, đừng đoán:</p>
<div class="code-copy-outer-scaffold"><div class="sourceCode" id="cb10"><pre class="sourceCode bash code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb10-1"><a href="#cb10-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ex">perf_analyzer</span> <span class="at">-m</span> model_name <span class="at">-i</span> http <span class="at">--concurrency-range</span> 1:64:4 <span class="at">-f</span> perf_http.csv</span>
<span id="cb10-2"><a href="#cb10-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ex">perf_analyzer</span> <span class="at">-m</span> model_name <span class="at">-i</span> grpc <span class="at">--concurrency-range</span> 1:64:4 <span class="at">-f</span> perf_grpc.csv</span></code></pre></div><button title="Copy to Clipboard" class="code-copy-button"><i class="bi"></i></button></div>
<p>So <code>Concurrency</code>, <code>Inferences/Second</code>, <code>p99 latency</code> giữa hai CSV. Hỏi: protocol nào tốt hơn về p99/TP? Ổn định qua nhiều lần chạy? Payload size có ảnh hưởng?</p>
<p><strong>Model Analyzer report</strong> tìm: throughput, p99, GPU memory/util, instance count, batch size, dynamic batching config. Config TP cao nhất ≠ production tốt nhất — chọn theo constraint TP + p99 + mem + error=0.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="sec-timeline-metrics" class="level2" data-number="7.7">
<h2 data-number="7.7" class="anchored" data-anchor-id="sec-timeline-metrics"><span class="header-section-number">7.7</span> Nsight Systems và Triton metrics</h2>
<blockquote class="blockquote">
<p>Khi số đo “chậm” nhưng chưa nói vì sao — timeline và metrics server nói gì?</p>
</blockquote>
<div class="callout callout-style-default callout-important no-icon callout-titled">
<div class="callout-header d-flex align-content-center">
<div class="callout-icon-container">
<i class="callout-icon no-icon"></i>
</div>
<div class="callout-title-container flex-fill">
<span class="screen-reader-only">Quan trọng</span>Ý chính
</div>
</div>
<div class="callout-body-container callout-body">
<p>Nsight Systems trả lời <strong>khi nào</strong> CPU/GPU chạy, gap, copy, sync. Nsight Compute trả lời <strong>vì sao</strong> một kernel chậm — chỉ sau khi đã biết kernel nghi ngờ. Triton <code>/metrics</code> tách queue vs compute; dùng <strong>focused profiling</strong> + NVTX thay vì profile cả server mù quáng.</p>
</div>
</div>
<p>Dùng <code>nsys</code> khi: PA/<code>trtexec</code> nói chậm nhưng không giải thích; gap giữa kernels; CPU overhead; H2D/D2H bất thường; sync nhiều; Python/C++ nghi nghẽn; p99 spike metrics chưa đủ.</p>
<div class="code-copy-outer-scaffold"><div class="sourceCode" id="cb11"><pre class="sourceCode bash code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb11-1"><a href="#cb11-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ex">nsys</span> profile <span class="at">--trace</span><span class="op">=</span>cuda,nvtx,osrt <span class="at">--output</span><span class="op">=</span>infer_report python infer.py</span>
<span id="cb11-2"><a href="#cb11-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ex">nsys-ui</span> infer_report.nsys-rep</span>
<span id="cb11-3"><a href="#cb11-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ex">nsys</span> stats infer_report.nsys-rep</span></code></pre></div><button title="Copy to Clipboard" class="code-copy-button"><i class="bi"></i></button></div>
<div class="code-copy-outer-scaffold"><div class="sourceCode" id="cb12"><pre class="sourceCode python code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode python"><span id="cb12-1"><a href="#cb12-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="im">import</span> nvtx</span>
<span id="cb12-2"><a href="#cb12-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb12-3"><a href="#cb12-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">with</span> nvtx.annotate(<span class="st">"preprocess"</span>):</span>
<span id="cb12-4"><a href="#cb12-4" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    x <span class="op">=</span> preprocess(image)</span>
<span id="cb12-5"><a href="#cb12-5" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">with</span> nvtx.annotate(<span class="st">"inference"</span>):</span>
<span id="cb12-6"><a href="#cb12-6" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    y <span class="op">=</span> session.run(<span class="va">None</span>, {<span class="st">"input"</span>: x})</span>
<span id="cb12-7"><a href="#cb12-7" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">with</span> nvtx.annotate(<span class="st">"postprocess"</span>):</span>
<span id="cb12-8"><a href="#cb12-8" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    result <span class="op">=</span> postprocess(y)</span></code></pre></div><button title="Copy to Clipboard" class="code-copy-button"><i class="bi"></i></button></div>
<p>Focused: warmup → start profile → measured iters → stop (<code>cudaProfilerStart/Stop</code> hoặc NVTX).</p>
<p><strong>Hướng A — profile Triton server rồi gửi load:</strong></p>
<div class="code-copy-outer-scaffold"><div class="sourceCode" id="cb13"><pre class="sourceCode bash code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb13-1"><a href="#cb13-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ex">nsys</span> profile <span class="at">--trace</span><span class="op">=</span>cuda,nvtx,osrt <span class="at">--output</span><span class="op">=</span>triton_server_profile <span class="dt">\</span></span>
<span id="cb13-2"><a href="#cb13-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  tritonserver <span class="at">--model-repository</span><span class="op">=</span>/models</span>
<span id="cb13-3"><a href="#cb13-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co"># terminal khác:</span></span>
<span id="cb13-4"><a href="#cb13-4" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ex">perf_analyzer</span> <span class="at">-m</span> resnet50 <span class="at">-i</span> grpc <span class="at">--concurrency-range</span> 8</span></code></pre></div><button title="Copy to Clipboard" class="code-copy-button"><i class="bi"></i></button></div>
<p><strong>Hướng B:</strong> profile custom backend/Python app. Production server lớn → focused profiling hoặc trace sampling, tránh report khổng lồ.</p>
<p>CPU timeline xem: client/server/backend/Python threads, CUDA API, sync, NVTX. GPU timeline xem: kernels, memcpy H2D/D2H, streams, idle gaps.</p>
<table class="caption-top table">
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 72%">
<col style="width: 28%">
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr class="header">
<th style="text-align: left;">Pattern timeline</th>
<th style="text-align: left;">Gợi ý</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;">Gap giữa kernels</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">GPU chờ CPU launch hoặc data</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td style="text-align: left;">Nhiều tiny kernels (10 µs + gap 30 µs)</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Launch overhead → fusion / CUDA Graph</td>
</tr>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;">H2D→kernels→D2H lặp</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Copy về CPU giữa pipeline</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td style="text-align: left;"><code>cudaDeviceSynchronize</code> / <code>cudaMalloc</code> mỗi request</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Sync/alloc trong hot path</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p>Nsight Systems: <em>when</em>. Nsight Compute: occupancy, memory throughput, Tensor Core, warp stalls — sau khi đã pinpoint kernel.</p>
<div class="code-copy-outer-scaffold"><div class="sourceCode" id="cb14"><pre class="sourceCode bash code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb14-1"><a href="#cb14-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ex">curl</span> localhost:8002/metrics <span class="kw">|</span> <span class="fu">head</span></span></code></pre></div><button title="Copy to Clipboard" class="code-copy-button"><i class="bi"></i></button></div>
<p>Nhóm metrics: request success/failure/count/exec; request/queue/compute_*_duration_us; GPU util/memory. Queue↑ = saturation hoặc batch delay. Interpret cùng latency/TP/p99 — không chỉ GPU util.</p>
<p>Trace (format có thể đổi theo version):</p>
<div class="code-copy-outer-scaffold"><div class="sourceCode" id="cb15"><pre class="sourceCode bash code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb15-1"><a href="#cb15-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ex">tritonserver</span> <span class="at">--model-repository</span><span class="op">=</span>/models <span class="dt">\</span></span>
<span id="cb15-2"><a href="#cb15-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="at">--trace-config</span> triton,file=/tmp/trace.json <span class="dt">\</span></span>
<span id="cb15-3"><a href="#cb15-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="at">--trace-config</span> triton,log-frequency=50 <span class="dt">\</span></span>
<span id="cb15-4"><a href="#cb15-4" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="at">--trace-config</span> rate=100 <span class="at">--trace-config</span> level=TIMESTAMPS <span class="dt">\</span></span>
<span id="cb15-5"><a href="#cb15-5" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="at">--trace-config</span> count=100</span></code></pre></div><button title="Copy to Clipboard" class="code-copy-button"><i class="bi"></i></button></div>

</div>

</div>

Tên có thể đổi — luôn đối chiếu output thật.</p>

<section id="sec-bottlenecks" class="level2" data-number="7.8">
<h2 data-number="7.8" class="anchored" data-anchor-id="sec-bottlenecks"><span class="header-section-number">7.8</span> Bottleneck playbook</h2>
<blockquote class="blockquote">
<p>Thấy chậm rồi nhảy tối ưu — hay đi symptom → evidence → hypothesis → experiment?</p>
</blockquote>
<div class="callout callout-style-default callout-important no-icon callout-titled">
<div class="callout-header d-flex align-content-center">
<div class="callout-icon-container">
<i class="callout-icon no-icon"></i>
</div>
<div class="callout-title-container flex-fill">
<span class="screen-reader-only">Quan trọng</span>Ý chính
</div>
</div>
<div class="callout-body-container callout-body">
<p>Chuỗi bắt buộc: <strong>symptom → metric evidence → hypothesis → experiment → fix → remeasure</strong>. Một bảng triệu chứng thay cho đoán mò; case study cho thấy <code>trtexec</code> nhanh / Triton chậm không mâu thuẫn.</p>
</div>
</div>

<thead>

<th style="text-align: left;">Hành động</th>

<td style="text-align: left;">profile CPU, gRPC, tối ưu preprocess</td>

<td style="text-align: left;">tăng concurrency/batch/dynamic batch</td>
</tr>

<td style="text-align: left;">pinned, GPU preprocess, shared mem</td>
</tr>

<td style="text-align: left;">D2H cao</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">output copy lớn</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">output/postprocess CPU</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">giảm output, GPU postprocess, top-k GPU</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td style="text-align: left;">Enqueue cao</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">enqueue &gt; GPU</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">CPU launch</td>

</tr>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;">Một layer chiếm nhiều</td>

<td style="text-align: left;">inspect precision, QAT, so batch</td>
</tr>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;">Dynamic batching↑ p99</td>

<div class="callout callout-style-default callout-tip no-icon callout-titled">
<div class="callout-header d-flex align-content-center collapsed" data-bs-toggle="collapse" data-bs-target=".callout-19-contents" aria-controls="callout-19" aria-expanded="false" aria-label="Toggle callout">
<div class="callout-icon-container">
<i class="callout-icon no-icon"></i>
</div>
<div class="callout-title-container flex-fill">
<span class="screen-reader-only">Mẹo</span>Case studies (số liệu)
</div>
<div class="callout-btn-toggle d-inline-block border-0 py-1 ps-1 pe-0 float-end"><i class="callout-toggle"></i></div>
</div>
<div id="callout-19" class="callout-19-contents callout-collapse collapse">
<div class="callout-body-container callout-body">
<p><strong>CS1:</strong> <code>trtexec</code> median <strong>2 ms</strong> vs PA p50=<strong>15</strong> / p99=<strong>80</strong> — không mâu thuẫn (<code>trtexec</code> = engine; Triton thêm serialize, network, queue, batching, I/O). Debug: CSV breakdown (Client Send … Client Recv) + metrics <code>request</code>/<code>queue</code>/<code>compute_infer</code> duration. So <strong>Server Compute Infer</strong> với <code>trtexec</code>: ≈ → overhead ngoài compute; ≫ → backend/shape/batch/precision/instance mismatch.</p>
<p><strong>CS2:</strong> GPU util <strong>25%</strong>, p99=<strong>200</strong>, Queue low, Client Send/Recv high → client/network. Thử client local, gRPC, giảm payload, binary tensor, kiểm preprocess client. Latency giảm mạnh khi local → không phải GPU.</p>
<p><strong>CS3:</strong> <code>max_queue_delay_microseconds: 10000</code> → TP <strong>+40%</strong>, p99 <strong>80→180</strong>. Giảm delay, bỏ preferred batch không cần, tăng instance, chọn OP theo p99 (không chỉ max TP).</p>
<p><strong>CS4:</strong> FP16 p50 <strong>4.0 ms</strong> vs INT8 <strong>4.3 ms</strong> — dumpProfile, precision fallback, so <code>--noDataTransfers</code>, batch 1/8/16/32, kiểm accuracy trước khi kết luận “INT8 chậm hơn”.</p>
<p><strong>CS5:</strong> p99 spike mỗi <strong>~5 phút</strong>, queue spike — poll/reload, logging, cron, scrape nặng, GC, contention. Time-align logs, Triton trace, <code>nsys</code> quanh cửa sổ spike.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="sec-workflow" class="level2" data-number="7.9">
<h2 data-number="7.9" class="anchored" data-anchor-id="sec-workflow"><span class="header-section-number">7.9</span> Workflow E2E và production</h2>
<blockquote class="blockquote">
<p>Từ model mới tới operating point an toàn — các bước nào và lỗi nào tránh?</p>
</blockquote>
<div class="callout callout-style-default callout-important no-icon callout-titled">
<div class="callout-header d-flex align-content-center">
<div class="callout-icon-container">
<i class="callout-icon no-icon"></i>
</div>
<div class="callout-title-container flex-fill">
<span class="screen-reader-only">Quan trọng</span>Ý chính
</div>
</div>
<div class="callout-body-container callout-body">
<p>Correctness trước performance. Workflow: env → <code>trtexec</code> shapes → Triton repo → health → PA single → PA sweep (+ metrics) → plot (µs→ms) → chọn OP dưới SLO → Nsight nếu cần → report. Production capacity = <strong>max safe TP under SLO with headroom</strong>.</p>
</div>
</div>

<colgroup>
<col style="width: 15%">
<col style="width: 26%">
<col style="width: 57%">
</colgroup>
<thead>

<th style="text-align: left;">Step</th>
<th style="text-align: left;">Việc làm</th>
<th style="text-align: left;">Lệnh / ghi chú chính</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;">0</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Correctness</td>

</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td style="text-align: left;">1</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Environment</td>
<td style="text-align: left;"><code>nvidia-smi</code> + print TensorRT/ORT versions</td>
</tr>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;">2</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Baseline <code>trtexec</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left;">build FP16 dynamic; loop batch 1…32 + dumpProfile</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td style="text-align: left;">3–4</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Triton repo + start</td>
<td style="text-align: left;"><code>model_repository/.../model.plan</code>; <code>docker run ... tritonserver</code></td>
</tr>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;">5</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Health</td>
<td style="text-align: left;"><code>curl .../v2/health/ready</code>; model metadata</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">

<td style="text-align: left;">concurrency 1; rồi <code>1:128:4</code> + <code>--collect-metrics</code></td>
</tr>
<tr class="odd">

<td style="text-align: left;">Operating point</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">max TP s.t. p99&lt;SLO, error=0, mem OK, headroom</td>
</tr>

<tr class="even">
<td style="text-align: left;">11</td>

<td style="text-align: left;">reproducible: env, tables, curve, bottleneck, recommendation</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<span id="cb16-2"><a href="#cb16-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ex">python</span> <span class="at">-</span> <span class="op">&lt;&lt;'PY'</span></span>
<span id="cb16-3"><a href="#cb16-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="st">import sys</span></span>
<span id="cb16-4"><a href="#cb16-4" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="st">print("python", sys.version)</span></span>
<span id="cb16-5"><a href="#cb16-5" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="st">try:</span></span>

<p>Candidate OP: max TP s.t. p99 &lt; SLO, error/timeout = 0, GPU mem OK, còn headroom (không chạy sát saturation). Báo cáo tối thiểu: env + bảng trtexec/PA + curve + bottleneck + recommendation config.</p>
</div>

<section id="lab-2-trtexec-static-dynamic-layer" class="level3 unnumbered">
<h3 class="unnumbered anchored" data-anchor-id="lab-2-trtexec-static-dynamic-layer">Lab 2: trtexec static + dynamic + layer</h3>
<div class="code-copy-outer-scaffold"><div class="sourceCode" id="cb17"><pre class="sourceCode bash code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb17-1"><a href="#cb17-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ex">trtexec</span> <span class="at">--onnx</span><span class="op">=</span>model.onnx <span class="at">--saveEngine</span><span class="op">=</span>model_fp16.plan <span class="dt">\</span></span>
<span id="cb17-2"><a href="#cb17-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="at">--shapes</span><span class="op">=</span>input:1x3x224x224 <span class="at">--fp16</span> <span class="at">--verbose</span> <span class="op">&gt;</span> build_fp16.log</span>
<span id="cb17-3"><a href="#cb17-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ex">trtexec</span> <span class="at">--loadEngine</span><span class="op">=</span>model_fp16.plan <span class="at">--shapes</span><span class="op">=</span>input:1x3x224x224 <span class="op">&gt;</span> bench_fp16_b1.log</span>
<span id="cb17-4"><a href="#cb17-4" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">grep</span> <span class="at">-E</span> <span class="st">"Throughput|Latency|Enqueue|H2D|GPU Compute|D2H|Total Host|Total GPU"</span> bench_fp16_b1.log</span>
<span id="cb17-5"><a href="#cb17-5" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb17-6"><a href="#cb17-6" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ex">trtexec</span> <span class="at">--onnx</span><span class="op">=</span>model.onnx <span class="at">--saveEngine</span><span class="op">=</span>model_dynamic_fp16.plan <span class="at">--fp16</span> <span class="dt">\</span></span>
<span id="cb17-7"><a href="#cb17-7" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="at">--minShapes</span><span class="op">=</span>input:1x3x224x224 <span class="at">--optShapes</span><span class="op">=</span>input:8x3x224x224 <span class="at">--maxShapes</span><span class="op">=</span>input:32x3x224x224</span>
<span id="cb17-8"><a href="#cb17-8" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">for</span> b <span class="kw">in</span> 1 2 4 8 16 32<span class="kw">;</span> <span class="cf">do</span></span>
<span id="cb17-9"><a href="#cb17-9" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="ex">trtexec</span> <span class="at">--loadEngine</span><span class="op">=</span>model_dynamic_fp16.plan <span class="at">--shapes</span><span class="op">=</span>input:<span class="va">${b}</span>x3x224x224 <span class="dt">\</span></span>
<span id="cb17-10"><a href="#cb17-10" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="op">&gt;</span> bench_dynamic_b<span class="va">${b}</span>.log</span>
<span id="cb17-11"><a href="#cb17-11" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">done</span></span>
<span id="cb17-12"><a href="#cb17-12" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb17-13"><a href="#cb17-13" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ex">trtexec</span> <span class="at">--loadEngine</span><span class="op">=</span>model_dynamic_fp16.plan <span class="at">--shapes</span><span class="op">=</span>input:8x3x224x224 <span class="dt">\</span></span>
<span id="cb17-14"><a href="#cb17-14" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="at">--profilingVerbosity</span><span class="op">=</span>detailed <span class="at">--dumpLayerInfo</span> <span class="at">--dumpProfile</span> <span class="at">--separateProfileRun</span> <span class="dt">\</span></span>
<span id="cb17-15"><a href="#cb17-15" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="op">&gt;</span> profile_layers.log</span></code></pre></div><button title="Copy to Clipboard" class="code-copy-button"><i class="bi"></i></button></div>
<p>Quan sát: GPU Compute % Host Latency? H2D/D2H đáng kể? Enqueue &gt; GPU? <code>--noDataTransfers</code> đổi gì? Batch nào sample TP cao nhất / latency thấp nhất? <code>opt</code> có nhanh nhất? Production batch=1 thì profile có hợp? Top layer Time(%) / type / precision / conversion / Q-DQ / fusion?</p>
</section>
<section id="lab-3-perf-analyzer-sweep-curve-metrics" class="level3 unnumbered">
<h3 class="unnumbered anchored" data-anchor-id="lab-3-perf-analyzer-sweep-curve-metrics">Lab 3: Perf Analyzer sweep + curve + metrics</h3>
<div class="code-copy-outer-scaffold"><div class="sourceCode" id="cb18"><pre class="sourceCode bash code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb18-1"><a href="#cb18-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ex">docker</span> run <span class="at">--gpus</span> all <span class="at">--rm</span> <span class="at">--net</span> host <span class="dt">\</span></span>
<span id="cb18-2"><a href="#cb18-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="at">-v</span> <span class="va">$(</span><span class="bu">pwd</span><span class="va">)</span>/model_repository:/models <span class="dt">\</span></span>
<span id="cb18-3"><a href="#cb18-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  nvcr.io/nvidia/tritonserver:<span class="op">&lt;</span>RELEASE<span class="op">&gt;</span>-py3 <span class="dt">\</span></span>
<span id="cb18-4"><a href="#cb18-4" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  tritonserver <span class="at">--model-repository</span><span class="op">=</span>/models</span>
<span id="cb18-5"><a href="#cb18-5" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb18-6"><a href="#cb18-6" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ex">perf_analyzer</span> <span class="at">-m</span> model_name <span class="at">-i</span> grpc <span class="at">--concurrency-range</span> 1:64:4 <span class="at">-f</span> perf_concurrency.csv</span>
<span id="cb18-7"><a href="#cb18-7" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ex">perf_analyzer</span> <span class="at">-m</span> model_name <span class="at">-i</span> grpc <span class="at">--concurrency-range</span> 1:64:4 <span class="dt">\</span></span>
<span id="cb18-8"><a href="#cb18-8" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="at">--collect-metrics</span> <span class="at">--verbose-csv</span> <span class="at">-f</span> perf_metrics.csv</span></code></pre></div><button title="Copy to Clipboard" class="code-copy-button"><i class="bi"></i></button></div>
<div class="code-copy-outer-scaffold"><div class="sourceCode" id="cb19"><pre class="sourceCode python code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode python"><span id="cb19-1"><a href="#cb19-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="im">import</span> pandas <span class="im">as</span> pd</span>
<span id="cb19-2"><a href="#cb19-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="im">import</span> matplotlib.pyplot <span class="im">as</span> plt</span>
<span id="cb19-3"><a href="#cb19-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb19-4"><a href="#cb19-4" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>df <span class="op">=</span> pd.read_csv(<span class="st">"perf_concurrency.csv"</span>)</span>
<span id="cb19-5"><a href="#cb19-5" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">for</span> col <span class="kw">in</span> [<span class="st">"p50 latency"</span>, <span class="st">"p90 latency"</span>, <span class="st">"p95 latency"</span>, <span class="st">"p99 latency"</span>]:</span>
<span id="cb19-6"><a href="#cb19-6" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="cf">if</span> col <span class="kw">in</span> df.columns:</span>
<span id="cb19-7"><a href="#cb19-7" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        df[col <span class="op">+</span> <span class="st">" (ms)"</span>] <span class="op">=</span> df[col] <span class="op">/</span> <span class="fl">1000.0</span></span>
<span id="cb19-8"><a href="#cb19-8" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb19-9"><a href="#cb19-9" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>plt.figure()</span>
<span id="cb19-10"><a href="#cb19-10" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>plt.plot(df[<span class="st">"Inferences/Second"</span>], df[<span class="st">"p99 latency"</span>] <span class="op">/</span> <span class="fl">1000.0</span>, marker<span class="op">=</span><span class="st">"o"</span>)</span>
<span id="cb19-11"><a href="#cb19-11" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>plt.xlabel(<span class="st">"Inferences/Second"</span>)</span>
<span id="cb19-12"><a href="#cb19-12" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>plt.ylabel(<span class="st">"p99 latency (ms)"</span>)</span>
<span id="cb19-13"><a href="#cb19-13" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>plt.title(<span class="st">"p99 latency vs throughput"</span>)</span>
<span id="cb19-14"><a href="#cb19-14" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>plt.grid(<span class="va">True</span>)</span>
<span id="cb19-15"><a href="#cb19-15" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>plt.savefig(<span class="st">"latency_throughput_curve.png"</span>, dpi<span class="op">=</span><span class="dv">160</span>)</span></code></pre></div><button title="Copy to Clipboard" class="code-copy-button"><i class="bi"></i></button></div>
<p>Ghi: knee point; max TP under p99 SLO; recommended OP; headroom. Plateau ở concurrency nào? p99 vượt SLO ở đâu? Server Queue tăng từ đâu? GPU util/memory theo concurrency?</p>
</section>
<section id="lab-4-optional-nsight-nvtx" class="level3 unnumbered">
<h3 class="unnumbered anchored" data-anchor-id="lab-4-optional-nsight-nvtx">Lab 4 (optional): Nsight + NVTX</h3>
<div class="code-copy-outer-scaffold"><div class="sourceCode" id="cb20"><pre class="sourceCode bash code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb20-1"><a href="#cb20-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ex">nsys</span> profile <span class="at">--trace</span><span class="op">=</span>cuda,nvtx,osrt <span class="at">--output</span><span class="op">=</span>infer_loop_profile python infer_loop.py</span></code></pre></div><button title="Copy to Clipboard" class="code-copy-button"><i class="bi"></i></button></div>
<p>Trong vòng lặp: annotate <code>preprocess</code> / <code>inference</code> / <code>postprocess</code>. Hỏi: CPU gap trước kernels? H2D/D2H? Overlap? Sync hot path? Tiny kernels?</p>
<div class="callout callout-style-default callout-tip no-icon callout-titled">
<div class="callout-header d-flex align-content-center collapsed" data-bs-toggle="collapse" data-bs-target=".callout-24-contents" aria-controls="callout-24" aria-expanded="false" aria-label="Toggle callout">
<div class="callout-icon-container">
<i class="callout-icon no-icon"></i>
</div>
<div class="callout-title-container flex-fill">
<span class="screen-reader-only">Mẹo</span>Labs phụ (5–12) + mini project
</div>
<div class="callout-btn-toggle d-inline-block border-0 py-1 ps-1 pe-0 float-end"><i class="callout-toggle"></i></div>
</div>
<div id="callout-24" class="callout-24-contents callout-collapse collapse">
<div class="callout-body-container callout-body">
<p><strong>Lab 5–6 (đã gộp Lab 3):</strong> concurrency sweep → plot curve → chọn knee / OP dưới SLO.<br>
<strong>Lab 7:</strong> HTTP vs gRPC (xem tip Perf Analyzer).<br>
<strong>Lab 8:</strong> <code>--collect-metrics --verbose-csv</code>; ghi GPU util/memory theo concurrency.<br>
<strong>Lab 9:</strong> <code>curl localhost:8002/metrics | head</code> trong lúc PA chạy — đối chiếu queue vs compute.<br>
<strong>Lab 10:</strong> bật <code>--trace-config</code> (rate/level/count/file) + PA concurrency ~32; mở <code>trace.json</code> khi p99 spike.<br>
<strong>Lab 11:</strong> <code>infer_loop.py</code> + NVTX <code>preprocess</code>/<code>inference</code>/<code>postprocess</code> + <code>nsys profile</code>.<br>
<strong>Lab 12 — template <code>benchmark_report.md</code>:</strong> Summary → Environment → Model → trtexec Results → PA Results → Latency–throughput Curve → Bottleneck Analysis → Recommendation.</p>
<p><strong>Mini project</strong> (input <code>model.onnx</code> hoặc <code>.plan</code>):</p>
<ol type="1">
<li>Build FP16 <code>trtexec</code> → bench batch 1/4/8/16 → dumpProfile<br>
</li>
<li>Serve Triton → PA concurrency 1:64 → thu GPU metrics → vẽ curve<br>
</li>
<li>Chọn OP theo SLO; <code>nsys</code> nếu chưa rõ bottleneck → viết report</li>
</ol>
<p><strong>SLO giả định:</strong> p99 &lt; 100 ms · error = 0 · GPU mem &lt; 80%.</p>
<p><strong>Deliverables:</strong> <code>benchmark_report.md</code>, trtexec logs, PA CSV, plot, bottleneck notes, recommended <code>config.pbtxt</code>.</p>
<div class="code-copy-outer-scaffold"><div class="sourceCode" id="cb21"><pre class="sourceCode markdown code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode markdown"><span id="cb21-1"><a href="#cb21-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">## Recommendation</span></span>
<span id="cb21-2"><a href="#cb21-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>Deploy <span class="in">`model_fp16.plan`</span> with:</span>
<span id="cb21-3"><a href="#cb21-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ss">- </span>max_batch_size: …</span>
<span id="cb21-4"><a href="#cb21-4" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ss">- </span>dynamic_batching: …</span>
<span id="cb21-5"><a href="#cb21-5" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ss">- </span>instance_group: …</span>
<span id="cb21-6"><a href="#cb21-6" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ss">- </span>preferred protocol: …</span>
<span id="cb21-7"><a href="#cb21-7" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ss">- </span>expected throughput / p99 / GPU util / GPU memory:</span>
<span id="cb21-8"><a href="#cb21-8" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ss">- </span>known risks:</span></code></pre></div><button title="Copy to Clipboard" class="code-copy-button"><i class="bi"></i></button></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</section>

<section id="checkpoint-questions" class="level2 unnumbered">
<h2 class="unnumbered anchored" data-anchor-id="checkpoint-questions">Checkpoint questions</h2>
<ol type="1">
<li>Vì sao <code>trtexec</code> nhanh không đảm bảo Triton service nhanh?<br>
</li>
<li>Throughput requests/s khác samples/s thế nào?<br>
</li>
<li>Vì sao p99 quan trọng hơn mean trong SLO?<br>
</li>
<li>Client-side latency gồm những thành phần nào?<br>
</li>
<li>Server-side latency gồm những thành phần nào?<br>
</li>
<li>Server Queue tăng nghĩa là gì?<br>
</li>
<li>Enqueue Time cao trong <code>trtexec</code> gợi ý gì?<br>
</li>
<li>H2D/D2H cao thì nên tối ưu gì?<br>
</li>
<li>GPU Compute Time cao thì nên tối ưu gì?<br>
</li>
<li>Vì sao dynamic batching có thể làm p99 xấu hơn?<br>
</li>
<li>Concurrency khác request rate thế nào?<br>
</li>
<li>Khi nào dùng request-rate mode thay concurrency mode?<br>
</li>
<li>Model Analyzer khác Perf Analyzer thế nào?<br>
</li>
<li>Nsight Systems trả lời câu hỏi gì mà PA không trả lời được?<br>
</li>
<li>Dấu hiệu Nsight cho CPU launch overhead?<br>
</li>
<li>Khi nào cần Nsight Compute?<br>
</li>
<li>Vì sao cần warmup?<br>
</li>
<li>Vì sao không trộn engine build với inference time?<br>
</li>
<li>Vì sao GPU utilization cao chưa chắc tốt?<br>
</li>
<li>Chọn production config theo max TP hay TP under p99 SLO?</li>
</ol>
<div class="callout callout-style-default callout-tip no-icon callout-titled">
<div class="callout-header d-flex align-content-center collapsed" data-bs-toggle="collapse" data-bs-target=".callout-25-contents" aria-controls="callout-25" aria-expanded="false" aria-label="Toggle callout">
<div class="callout-icon-container">
<i class="callout-icon no-icon"></i>
</div>
<div class="callout-title-container flex-fill">
<span class="screen-reader-only">Mẹo</span>Tự kiểm — đáp án ngắn
</div>
<div class="callout-btn-toggle d-inline-block border-0 py-1 ps-1 pe-0 float-end"><i class="callout-toggle"></i></div>
</div>
<div id="callout-25" class="callout-25-contents callout-collapse collapse">
<div class="callout-body-container callout-body">
<ol type="1">
<li>PA đo thêm network, queue, batching, serialize, preprocess, concurrency.<br>
</li>
<li>samples/s ≈ requests/s × batch.<br>
</li>
<li>User/SLO cảm nhận worst-case; mean che tail.<br>
</li>
<li>Send + network + server path + recv (toàn bộ phía client thấy).<br>
</li>
<li>Nhận request → queue → compute in/infer/out → gửi response.<br>
</li>
<li>Request chờ trước execute — saturation/batch delay/thiếu instance.<br>
</li>
<li>Host/CPU launch overhead; thử CUDA Graph/fusion/batch.<br>
</li>
<li>Pinned memory, giữ data trên GPU, giảm tensor, shared mem.<br>
</li>
<li>Precision, batch, fusion, architecture, layer profile.<br>
</li>
<li>Chờ gom batch làm queue delay tăng tail.<br>
</li>
<li>Outstanding đồng thời vs tốc độ gửi có chủ đích.<br>
</li>
<li>Khi traffic production mô tả bằng arrival rate (RPS).<br>
</li>
<li>PA đo một config; MA sweep nhiều config + memory/util.<br>
</li>
<li>Timeline: khi nào CPU/GPU, gap, copy, sync.<br>
</li>
<li>Nhiều tiny kernels + gap lớn giữa chúng.<br>
</li>
<li>Đã biết kernel/layer cụ thể đáng nghi.<br>
</li>
<li>Loại cold start (CUDA, load, cache) khỏi steady-state.<br>
</li>
<li>Build có thể phút; production không build mỗi request.<br>
</li>
<li>Có thể saturated, queue↑, p99 fail, bandwidth-bound.<br>
</li>
<li><strong>Throughput under p99 SLO</strong> (+ headroom, error=0).</li>
</ol>
</div>
</div>

<section id="glossary" class="level2 unnumbered">
<h2 class="unnumbered anchored" data-anchor-id="glossary">Glossary</h2>
<table class="caption-top table">
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 47%">
<col style="width: 52%">
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr class="header">
<th style="text-align: left;">Thuật ngữ</th>
<th style="text-align: left;">Định nghĩa</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;"><strong>Benchmark</strong></td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Đo performance theo methodology cụ thể</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td style="text-align: left;"><strong>Profiling</strong></td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Phân tích nơi thời gian/tài nguyên bị tiêu thụ</td>
</tr>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;"><strong>Latency</strong></td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Thời gian từ start tới finish (cần nêu điểm đo)</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td style="text-align: left;"><strong>Throughput</strong></td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Số inference/request/sample mỗi giây</td>
</tr>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;"><strong>Concurrency</strong></td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Số request outstanding cùng lúc</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td style="text-align: left;"><strong>Request rate</strong></td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Tốc độ gửi request vào server</td>
</tr>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;"><strong>p99</strong></td>
<td style="text-align: left;">99th percentile latency</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td style="text-align: left;"><strong>Tail latency</strong></td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Phần cuối phân phối (p95/p99/p999)</td>
</tr>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;"><strong>Queue time</strong></td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Thời gian chờ trước khi execute</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td style="text-align: left;"><strong>H2D / D2H</strong></td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Host-to-device / device-to-host transfer</td>
</tr>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;"><strong>Enqueue Time</strong></td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Thời gian host enqueue inference/CUDA work</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td style="text-align: left;"><strong>GPU Compute Time</strong></td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Thời gian GPU execute kernels</td>
</tr>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;"><strong>Dynamic batching</strong></td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Gom nhiều request thành batch để tăng util/TP</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td style="text-align: left;"><strong>Knee point</strong></td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Điểm latency tăng nhanh trong khi TP gần plateau</td>
</tr>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;"><strong>Saturation</strong></td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Tài nguyên gần full; queue thường tăng mạnh</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td style="text-align: left;"><strong>Nsight Systems</strong></td>
<td style="text-align: left;">System-wide profiler timeline CPU/GPU/CUDA</td>
</tr>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;"><strong>Nsight Compute</strong></td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Kernel-level profiler</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td style="text-align: left;"><strong>Prometheus metrics</strong></td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Metrics text endpoint để scrape/monitor</td>
</tr>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;"><strong>Warmup</strong></td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Iterations trước cửa sổ đo để loại cold start</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td style="text-align: left;"><strong>Operating point</strong></td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Config/load vận hành (thường gần knee dưới SLO)</td>
</tr>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;"><strong>Headroom</strong></td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Dung lượng dự phòng dưới saturation</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td style="text-align: left;"><strong>Client-side latency</strong></td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Đo từ phía client (gồm network)</td>
</tr>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;"><strong>Server-side latency</strong></td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Đo trong server (nhận → gửi)</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td style="text-align: left;"><strong>Focused profiling</strong></td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Chỉ profile vùng performance-critical</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</section>
<section id="summary" class="level2 unnumbered">
<h2 class="unnumbered anchored" data-anchor-id="summary">Summary</h2>
<ul>
<li>Đo trước khi tối ưu; methodology trước khi tin số; bottleneck analysis trước khi “sưu tập số”.<br>
</li>
<li>Tool map: <code>trtexec</code> = ceiling, PA = service, MA = config search, <code>nsys</code> = timeline, Prometheus = prod.<br>
</li>
<li>Luôn nêu điểm đo latency; report p50/p95/p99 + queue/compute — không chỉ mean/GPU util.<br>
</li>
<li>Chọn <strong>max TP under p99 SLO</strong> tại knee, giữ headroom.<br>
</li>
<li>Warmup; tách build/infer; control variables; input đại diện; Little’s Law để sanity-check.<br>
</li>
<li>Đọc <code>trtexec</code> theo case A–D (compute / copy / enqueue / underutilized).<br>
</li>
<li>PA: concurrency vs RPS; CSV breakdown; MA dưới constraint.<br>
</li>
<li>Timeline khi số đo chưa đủ; metrics để tách queue vs compute.<br>
</li>
<li>Playbook symptom→remeasure; lưu baseline cho regression.</li>
</ul>
<div class="callout callout-style-default callout-tip no-icon callout-titled">
<div class="callout-header d-flex align-content-center collapsed" data-bs-toggle="collapse" data-bs-target=".callout-26-contents" aria-controls="callout-26" aria-expanded="false" aria-label="Toggle callout">
<div class="callout-icon-container">
<i class="callout-icon no-icon"></i>
</div>
<div class="callout-title-container flex-fill">
<span class="screen-reader-only">Mẹo</span>Mental models cần nhớ
</div>
<div class="callout-btn-toggle d-inline-block border-0 py-1 ps-1 pe-0 float-end"><i class="callout-toggle"></i></div>
</div>
<div id="callout-26" class="callout-26-contents callout-collapse collapse">
<div class="callout-body-container callout-body">
<p>Đừng hỏi “model nhanh không?” — hỏi: nhanh <strong>ở đâu</strong> (engine/service/client), <strong>dưới load nào</strong>, <strong>metric nào</strong> (p99?), <strong>so với baseline nào</strong>.<br>
Benchmark là thí nghiệm: một thay đổi chính, control variables, warmup, lặp lại, report distribution.<br>
Tối ưu là vòng lặp: measure → hypothesize → change → remeasure.<br>
Max throughput ≠ production capacity — capacity = max <strong>safe</strong> TP under SLO + headroom.<br>
Một metric không bao giờ đủ: luôn cặp latency↔︎throughput, mean↔︎p99, util↔︎queue, compute↔︎copy.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</section>
